questions.question: Which of the following can't be the unit's digit of a perfect square?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

A square of a number is obtained by multiplying the number itself.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 1 × 1 = 1

⇒ 2 × 2 = 4

⇒ 3 × 3 = 9

⇒ 4 × 4 = 16

⇒ 5 × 5 = 25

⇒ 6 × 6 = 36

⇒ 7 × 7 = 49

⇒ 8 × 8 = 64

⇒ 9 × 9 = 81

⇒ 10 × 10 = 100

Here, we see that 8 can’t be the unit place of a perfect square

questions.question: Amar can complete a work in 30 days and Raman can complete the same work in 15 days. If both of them work together, then in 4 days what percent of the total work will be completed?
questions.solution:
Work done by Amar in 1 day is 1/30th of total work

Work done by Raman in 1 day is 1/15th of the total work

According to the problem statement, work done in 4 days can be given as

⇒ work done = 4 × (1/30 + 1/15)

Hence, 4/10 of the total work will be completed

⇒ percentage of total work = 4 × 100/10 = 40%

∴ the 40% of total work will be completed in 4 days

questions.question: The lengths of two parallel sides of a trapezium are 21 cm and 9 cm. If its height is 10 cm, then what is the area (in cm²) of the trapezium?
questions.solution:
**Try this too:** https://testbook.com/discuss/d/26209-how-to-save-time-in-mensuration-questions

**Detailed solution:**

Area of trapezium can be written as (1/2) × (sum of parallel sides) × height

⇒ Area = (1/2) × (21 + 9) × 10

⇒ Area = 150 cm²

∴ the area of trapezium is 150 cm²

questions.question: What will be the net discount percentage of three successive discounts of 20%, 10% and 30%?
questions.solution:
Let initial price be Rs. 100

From the problem statement, price after 3 successive discounts can be written as

⇒ final price = 100 × (1 – 20/100) × (1 – 10/100) × (1 – 30/100)

⇒ final price = 100 × (0.8) × (0.9) × (0.7)

⇒ final price = Rs. 50.4

⇒ Discount is 100 – 50.4 = Rs. 49.6

∴ the net discount is 49.6%

questions.question: Three bottles of equal capacity have mixture of milk and water in ratio 5 : 7, 7 : 9 and 2 : 1 respectively. These three bottles are emptied into a large bottle. What is the percentage of milk in the new mixture?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The bottles have equal capacity

Ratio of milk to water = 5 :7, 7:9, and 2 : 1 respectively

**Calculation:**

Let the capacity of each bottle be y

For bottle 1, milk be 5a and water be 7a

⇒ 5a + 7a = y

⇒ a = y/12 …(i)

For bottle 2, milk be 7b and water be 9b

⇒ 7b + 9b = y

⇒ b = y/16 …(ii)

For bottle 3, milk be 2c and water be c

⇒ 2c + c = y

⇒ c = y/3 …(iii)

⇒ Percentage of milk can be given as = (5a + 7b + 2c) × 100/(5a + 7b + 2c + 7a + 9b + c)

⇒ Percentage of milk = (5a + 7b + 2c) × 100/(12a + 16b + 3c) …from (i), (ii) and (iii)

⇒ Percentage of milk = (5 × y/12 + 7 × y/16 + 2 × y/3) × 100/(y + y + y)

⇒ Percentage of milk = 50.7%

**∴ the percentage of milk be 50.7%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Calculation:**

Let quantity of milk and water in bottle-1 = 5 + 7 = 12 units

Quantity of milk and water in bottle-2 = 7 + 9 = 16 units

And the quantity of milk and water in bottle-3 = 2 + 1 = 3 units

As we have an equal quantity of mixture in all bottles

Making the quantity in all bottles equal by making total quantity = 48 liters

For bottle-1

Milk : water = (5 : 7) × 4 = 20 : 28, total 48 liters

For bottle-2

Milk : water = (7 : 9) × 3 = 21 : 27, total 48 liters

Fore bottle-3

Milk : water = (2 : 1) × 16 = 32 : 16, total 48 liters

Total quantity of mixture = 48 × 3 = 144 liters

Total quantity of milk = 20 + 21 + 32 = 73 liters

Percentage of milk = 73/144 × 100

⇒ 0.5069 × 100 = 50.69 or 50.7 % 

**Hence, the percentage of milk in new mixture is 50.7**

questions.question: Seven friends spent Rs 14 each on a project and the eighth friend spent Rs 21 more than the average expenditure of all eight of them. What is the amount of total money (in Rs) spent by them?
questions.solution:
Let the average expenditure of all eight friends be Rs. x 

Seven friends spend Rs.14

Sum = 14 × 7 = Rs.98 

As per the question 

⇒ {(98 + x + 21) over 8 } = x

⇒ x + 119 = 8x 

⇒ 7x = 119 

⇒ x = 17 

The total amount spent by them all 

⇒ 98 + (17 + 21) = Rs.136

**∴ Total money spent by them is Rs. 136.**

questions.question: A person sold his pen for Rs 24 and his profit percentage was numerically equal to the cost price. What was the cost price (in Rs) of the pen?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price and profit percentage be y

From the problem’s statement

⇒ y × (1 + y/100) = 24

⇒ y² + 100y - 2400 = 0

⇒ (y – 20) (y + 120) = 0

Since y can’t be negative so y = 20 is the required solution

∴ the profit percentage and cost price be 20

questions.question: A, B and C are three students. A got 36% less marks than B and 16% more marks than C. If B got 145 marks, then what are the marks got by C?
questions.solution:
Let C’s mark be y

From the problem’s statement

A’s marks can be given as 16% more than that of C

⇒ A’s mark = y × (1 + 16/100) = 1.16y ..…(i)

And also A’s marks can be given as 36% less than that of B

⇒ A’s mark = 145 × (1 – 36/100) = 92.8 From (i)

⇒ 1.16y = 92.8

⇒ y = 80

∴ the C’s marks are 80

questions.question: After repairing a scooter runs at a speed of 54 km/h and before repairing runs at speed of 48 km/h. It covers a certain distance in 6 hours after repairing. How much time will it take to cover the same distance before repairing?
questions.solution:
In the given problem distance travelled is same

Let the time required finally be t

⇒ 54 × 6 = 48 × t

⇒ t = 6.75 hours = 6 hours 45 minutes

∴ the time required before repairing is 6 hours 45 minutes

questions.question: If a certain sum of money become thrice of itself in 5 years 4 months at simple interest, then what will be the yearly rate of interest (in %)?
questions.solution:
Let the rate of interest be r% and principle be y

Interest can be given as 3y – y = 2y

5 years 4 months can be written as 5 + 4/12 years = 16/3 years, using this in simple interest formula

Using simple interest formula

⇒ 2y = (y × r × 16/3) /100

⇒ r = 600/16 = 37.5

∴ The rate of interest is 37.5%

questions.question: If x + y = 4, then what is the value of (2)/({x - 2)} + (2)/({y - 2)}? (x, y ≥ 0)
questions.solution:
Possible cases are: 1. x = 4 and y = 0 or vice versa

2. x = 3 and y = 1 or vice versa (answer would come same in all the cases)

Let us assume x = 3 and y = 1 which satisfies the condition x + y = 4

⇒ 2/(x - 2) + 2/(y - 2)

⇒ 2/(3 - 2) + 2/(1 - 2) = 0

∴ 2/(x - 2) + 2/(y - 2) = 0

[Note: We cannot take x = y = 2, because division by 0 is not defined]

In ΔPQR, ∠QPR = 45° and the bisectors of ∠PQR and ∠PRQ meets at O. What is the value (in degrees) of ∠QOR?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

∠QPR = 45° 

Bisectors of ∠PQR and ∠PRQ meets at O.

**Calculation :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/038cf38d677cf01e4b43847c0429f0155dad6f49f945d4a485c8024e029ca5a4.png] 

From the given figure

For triangle PQR

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R = 180

⇒ x + y = 180 – 45 = 135

⇒ (x + y) /2 = 135/2 ---- (1)

For triangle QAP

⇒ ∠PQA + ∠QAP + ∠APQ = 180

⇒ x/2 + ∠QAP = 180 – 45 = 135

⇒ ∠QAP = 135 – x/2 ---- (2)

For triangle RBP

⇒ ∠PRB + ∠RBP + ∠BPR = 180

⇒ ∠RBP + y/2 = 180 – 45 = 135

⇒ ∠RBP = 135 – y/2 ---- (3)

For Quadrilateral PAOB

⇒ ∠AOB + ∠OBP + ∠BPA + ∠PAO = 360

⇒ ∠AOB = 360 – 135 + x/2 – 135 + y/2 – 45

⇒ ∠AOB = 45 + x/2 + y/2 Using (1)

⇒ ∠QOR = ∠AOB = 45 + 135/2

**∴ The ∠QOR is 112.5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick:__**Incase of incenters,

We can use the formula,

∠ QOR = 90 + 1 over 2 ∠P

⇒ ∠ QOR = 90 + 1/2(45)

⇒ ∠ QOR = 90 + 22.5 = 112.5° 

∴ ∠QOR is 112.5

questions.question: In triangle ABC, ∠ABC = 90°. BP is drawn perpendicular to AC. If ∠BAP = 30°, then what is the value (in degrees) of ∠PBC?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠ABC = 90° 

BP is perpendicular AC

∠ BAP = 30° 

**Calculation :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/443063e955d98f7c5ac05ae459bc47d0435f165492c78a8f051cd2cbbe0dfa1a.png] 

Since we know that ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180

⇒ ∠C = 180 - 90 - 30 = 60

Now in triangle BPC, given that ∠BPC = 90

⇒ ∠PBC + ∠BPC + ∠PCB = 180

⇒ ∠PBC = 180 - 90 - 60 = 30

∴ The ∠PBC is **30°**.
